script.name: Operational Systems Discovery
script.description: A seven-stage discovery script for operational/field software, anchored on business driver → current state → workflow → measures → environment → constraints → validation.

stages.title: Business driver
stages.objective: Capture the event, cost, urgency, and desired business outcome that initiated the effort.
stages.primary_prompt: What changed or happened that made solving this problem important now?
alternative_prompts: What does this cost you today if nothing changes?
completion_criteria: A concrete triggering event and business outcome are recorded.

stages.title: Current state
stages.objective: Map the existing workflow, actors, tools, delays, workarounds, and failure points.
stages.primary_prompt: Walk me through what happens today from order release through truck loading.
alternative_prompts: Where does the current process most often break down?
completion_criteria: The end-to-end current workflow and its pain points are described.

stages.title: Workflow decisions
stages.objective: Translate the broad problem into specific users, decisions, states, exceptions, and timing needs.
stages.primary_prompt: Which specific order states and exceptions must supervisors see to prevent a loading delay?
alternative_prompts: Who acts on each exception, and how quickly?
completion_criteria: The decisions, states, and actors are enumerated.

stages.title: Success measures
stages.objective: Define measurable response times, accuracy, throughput, availability, and business outcomes.
stages.primary_prompt: How will you measure whether the new visibility capability is successful after deployment?
alternative_prompts: What target would make this a clear win?
completion_criteria: At least one measurable success criterion is captured.

stages.title: Technical environment
stages.objective: Identify deployment targets, integration points, data sources, security boundaries, and limitations.
stages.primary_prompt: What make, model, operating system, and browser are used on the rugged tablets?
alternative_prompts: What systems hold the data you need, and how do they expose it?
completion_criteria: Devices and source systems are characterized.

stages.title: Constraints and risks
stages.objective: Explore schedule, budget, policy, connectivity, integration, migration, and operational risks.
stages.primary_prompt: Which functions must continue during intermittent connectivity, and for how long?
alternative_prompts: What must not change this year, and why?
completion_criteria: Key constraints and degraded-mode expectations are recorded.

stages.title: Validate and close
stages.objective: Read back objectives, needs, requirements, assumptions, gaps, owners, and next actions.
stages.primary_prompt: Let me summarize what I heard. Which part is incorrect, incomplete, or missing?
alternative_prompts: Which of these should we confirm before we baseline it?
completion_criteria: The customer has validated or corrected the derived set.

segments.speaker: facilitator
segments.text: What is the biggest operational problem you are trying to solve in the warehouse today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Our supervisors do not have a reliable real-time view of where orders are in the picking process. We usually find out about delays after a truck is already waiting.

segments.speaker: facilitator
segments.text: How quickly would the data need to update for it to be useful?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Ideally within 30 seconds. Anything over a couple of minutes is probably too stale to act on.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: We also need it to work on the rugged tablets the floor leads already carry, and we cannot replace the warehouse management system this year.

segments.speaker: facilitator
segments.text: Which functions have to remain available if connectivity is degraded?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It has to be live before our peak season, so we need go-live by the end of Q3, and it must keep working when the Wi-Fi drops in the yard.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Only shift supervisors should be able to reassign picks; floor staff just need to see status, not change it.

artifacts.title: Improve warehouse flow
artifacts.statement: Improve warehouse flow and prevent avoidable truck-loading delays.
artifacts.rationale: Two customer statements connect delayed visibility to downstream truck waiting.

artifacts.title: Timely operational visibility
artifacts.statement: Warehouse supervisors need timely visibility into order status throughout picking.
artifacts.rationale: Directly paraphrases the operational problem without prescribing a solution.

artifacts.title: Status refresh within 30 seconds
artifacts.statement: The solution shall refresh order-status information within 30 seconds of a source-system state change.
artifacts.rationale: The customer supplied a specific desired update interval. The event origin and percentile remain unresolved.

artifacts.title: Existing rugged tablets
artifacts.statement: The solution shall operate on the rugged tablets currently issued to floor leads.
artifacts.rationale: The customer explicitly requires use of existing field hardware; device details are still missing.

artifacts.title: Retain current WMS
artifacts.statement: The solution shall integrate with the existing WMS without requiring replacement this fiscal year.
artifacts.rationale: The customer explicitly ruled out replacement during the current year.

artifacts.title: Integration latency
artifacts.statement: Available WMS interfaces may not support a 30-second end-to-end refresh target.
artifacts.rationale: The performance requirement depends on an interface that has not yet been characterized.

artifacts.title: Which order states matter?
artifacts.statement: Which order states, exceptions, and alerts must supervisors see?
artifacts.rationale: The required content and decision use cases are not yet defined.

artifacts.title: Degraded-connectivity functions
artifacts.statement: Which functions must remain available during degraded connectivity, and for how long?
artifacts.rationale: Needed to derive offline operation, storage, and synchronization requirements.

artifacts.title: Q3 go-live deadline
artifacts.statement: The solution shall be delivered and live before the end of Q3, ahead of peak season.
artifacts.rationale: The customer stated a firm go-live deadline tied to peak season.

artifacts.title: Role-based reassignment
artifacts.statement: The solution shall restrict pick reassignment to shift supervisors; floor staff have read-only status access.
artifacts.rationale: Customer distinguished who may change vs. view picking data.

artifacts.title: Offline operation and sync
artifacts.statement: The solution shall continue core status functions during connectivity loss and reconcile data on reconnection.
artifacts.rationale: Yard Wi-Fi drops were reported; offline + synchronization behavior must be defined.

artifacts.title: Local caching on devices
artifacts.statement: It is assumed the rugged tablets can cache order data locally during short outages.
artifacts.rationale: Working assumption pending confirmation of device storage capabilities.

artifacts.title: Reduced loading delays
artifacts.statement: Success is measured by a reduction in truck wait time caused by late picking visibility.
artifacts.rationale: Derived from the stated business pain; target value still to be quantified.
